subject: Animation
title: Floyd Norman: Disney's First Black Animator
description: Learn Floyd Norman: Disney's First Black Animator in one minute.

hook.text: Floyd Norman joined Disney in 1956 and became the studio's first African American animator.

buildup.text: Norman worked on Sleeping Beauty, The Jungle Book, and many other classics alongside Walt Disney himself.

discovery.text: Walt Disney treated Norman as an equal in an era when racial discrimination was widespread in Hollywood.

twist.text: Disney forcibly retired Norman at age 65. He kept showing up to work anyway and was given a desk.

climax.text: Norman continued working into his 80s and became a beloved mentor to new generations of animators.

punchline.text: Disney retired him. He refused to leave and kept drawing.

quiz.question: What made Floyd Norman a pioneer at Disney?
options: He became Disney's first African American animator, working on classics like The Jungle Book
He directed the first Disney sequel
